title: Idea selection runs as a scheduled agent
description:
Requested by Humorus (HUM-b0d999). papyrus ideas select is a manual CLI run; there is no core agent definition for it. Register it like rate.yaml with a schedule (default: after the site's ideation run), adopted per site, at the site's rung (propose: the pick waits for an editor; draft: the pick goes on to the site's Story procedure, PPY-8fe7e6, and ends at a hard review request for a person).
Scenario: a site at rung draft gets one picked Idea drafted and a review request each day, and nothing publishes without a person. Scenario: a site at rung propose gets the pick as a review request only.
Standing rules: no workarounds, fallbacks or shims; Gherkin specs.
